exponent-clamp conformance — decimal-rs against decimal.js v10.6.0 @ cd73a7f
Operands built with minE/maxE wide, then the limits narrowed, then the
method called — the only arrangement in which the original's `new Ctor(x)`
is observable. 67 methods x 6 operands x 4 limit pairs, the 10 methods that take a rounding
mode across all 9 of them = 3528 calls.
sinh                 ok   [16/24 — 1.5e300 at maxE=100 and 1 more did not return in 10 s, in either implementation]
tanh                 ok   [10/24 — 1.5e300 at maxE=100 and 3 more did not return in 10 s, in either implementation]
asin                 ok   [22/24 — -0.125 at maxE=3 did not return in 10 s, in either implementation]
atan                 ok   [10/24 — 1.5e300 at maxE=100 and 3 more did not return in 10 s, in either implementation]
cosh                 ok (2 documented)   [12/24 — 1.5e300 at maxE=9000000000000000 and 3 more did not return in 10 s, in either implementation]
Every method agrees with the oracle under narrowed exponent limits.
18 documented divergence(s) encountered: upstream dereferences null on a value the clamps made infinite; the port answers (D-13, D-17).
5 method(s) had a case that neither implementation returns from; the rest of their cases were checked.
decimal-core sets unsafe_code = "forbid". `forbid` is not a lint level an
inner `allow` can turn off, so the crate does not compile if an unsafe
block appears anywhere in it — including one produced by a macro. The
declaration is the evidence and a successful `cargo build` is the check;
the counts above are only a textual cross-check of it, taken after
comments and string literals have been removed. Grepping for the word
would not do: this repository discusses unsafety at length in prose.
decimal-napi is the Node-API adapter and cannot be safe: every call into
the Node-API is an `extern "C"` function over raw pointers supplied by
V8. Its 93 uses are the boundary and nothing else — the adapter
contains no arithmetic. All of it is in 2581 lines against
9913 lines of arithmetic in decimal-core, which has none.
Dependencies: decimal-core has none at all. The workspace depends on
napi-sys, which is bindings only. `cargo geiger` will report unsafe inside
it, and that is unsafe in Node itself reached through a binding, not code
